  • Method Details

    • getInstrumentEntityName

      public String getInstrumentEntityName()
      Name of the daily CUD limit key that a bulk operation on the price data of this instrument consumes. Such an operation is accounted as one edit of the instrument itself, and a security and a currency pair have separate budgets, so the key follows the actual type of the parent.

      The test is instanceof rather than getClass().getSimpleName() on purpose: a currency pair is resolved through getReferenceById, which yields a Hibernate proxy whose simple name is not Currencypair. A proxy is still an instance of the entity it stands for.

      Returns:
      Security or Currencypair
